subject: prd/maintenance-jobs
statement: Require an append-only, schema-versioned local JSONL journal at that exact enrolled-repository path. Include pre-claim failures, installation and execution lifecycle, correlation/ownership, configuration and resolved route, terminal outcomes, publication and retained-evidence references. Serialize writers and exclude credentials. This explicitly requested path is the exception to the usual .pyxis/logs producer layout; it remains Git-ignored local diagnostics, with compact shared outcomes retained in the Git claim ref.
rationale: “ensure capturing the logs under .pyxis/maintenance/logs.jsonl” including success, failure, outcomes, and useful debug/audit information.
